subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-immutable` with a merge base, docgate shall fail any modify, delete, or rename of a flat placeholder-corpus file (a `.md` file directly under the configured PRDs path, excluding `README.md` and ledger directories) present at the merge base, while imposing no format, template, or content requirement on corpus files.
rationale: the corpus is citable requirement text (`corpus:` anchors, rule-4 stable IDs) with no mechanical stability; byte-freeze without retrofit resolves its undeclared mutability class (#54 C5)
fit_criterion: fixture: modify and delete of a merged flat corpus file each red naming the freeze; `README.md` edit green; a new flat file green; ledger directories unaffected; no content lint runs on corpus files; the real corpus green
